INTERLOCUTOR AMPHISBAENA CREATURE KYTON
CR 14

XP 38,400
Interlocutor amphisbaena creature kyton
LE Large outsider (evil, extraplanar, kyton, lawful)
Init +7; Senses all-around vision, darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +27

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 13, flat-footed 22 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +13 natural, –1 size)
hp 195 (17d10+102); regeneration 5 (good or silver weapons, good spells)
Fort +16, Ref +10, Will +18
Defensive Abilities split; DR 10/good or silver; Immune cold; SR 23

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 4 claws +26 (1d8+10/19–20 plus bleed)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks bleed (1d6), rend (2 claws, 1d8+15), special attacks, surgical strikes, unnerving gaze
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 14th; concentration +19)

At will—bleed (DC 15), stabilize
3/day—cure serious wounds, restoration
1/day—breath of life (DC 19)

TACTICS

During Combat The kyton seeks to keep victims alive but unconscious, ready for future work. It keeps a wreath of barbed wire for this, wrapping victims within its coils (it has enough for 12 Medium creatures) as a full-round action that provokes an attack of opportunity. Creatures held within can only escape using an Escape Artist check (DC 30), those who fail the check take 4d6 damage from the barbs.

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 17, Con 22, Int 16, Wis 23, Cha 20
Base Atk +17; CMB +28; CMD 42
Feats Agonizing Obedience, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Improved Iron Will, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +3 (+7 to jump), Heal +26, Intimidate +25, Knowledge (arcana) +10, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +13, Knowledge (local) +20, Knowledge (nature) +13, Knowledge (planes) +18, Knowledge (religion) +10, Perception +27, Sense Motive +23, Stealth +19, Survival +23; Racial Modifiers racial skill modifier
Languages Aboleth, Common, Elder Thing, Infernal, Weirdling
Gear roll of barbed wire.
